- **Discover searches like Home.** Triangle now opens the same search field
  Home uses, in the same place, with the PlayStation keyboard just beneath it.
  It says what you are searching — movies, shows, or both — following the
  All / Movies / Shows filter, and shows the result count beside it.
- **Smoother right-stick scrolling.** Library grids, Discover and Requests now
  ease into motion, speed up to double after about a second held and stay
  there, and glide to a stop when you let go instead of halting. The focus
  stays on a row that is fully on screen, so nothing snaps back afterwards.
- **A faster Discover.** Posters are sized once when they arrive rather than
  rescaled every frame: drawing the grid takes about 60% less time, and on the
  test console scrolling Discover went from missing one frame in five to
  almost none. Categories you visited in the last few minutes, and the
  category you return to after a search, open instantly from memory.
- **Posters through your request server.** When Seerr/Jellyseerr is set up by
  its local IP address, posters come through its image proxy on your network
  instead of from TMDB over the internet, falling back to TMDB if that fails.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
